See section.map.json / app-header.map.json for the model. page_header/1 is a fixed <div class="pc-page-header {class}"> wrapper around its `inner_block` (usually an <h2>). No modifiers, no fallback, no hook. Shared SSR features: the title slot + the root class passthrough.
